title: Recruiter / Talent Acquisition
description:
Were Hiring | Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Location: [Location]
 Experience: 1–5 Years
 Qualification: Graduate / MBA-HR / PGDM-HR
 Industry: Manufacturing / Engineering / Contract Staffing We are looking for an energetic and result-oriented Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Executive to join our recruitment team. Key Responsibilities Handle end-to-end recruitment from sourcing to joining
• Understand manpower requirements and prepare sourcing strategies
• Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, job portals, references and social media 
• Screen candidates based on job requirements
• Conduct initial candidate calls and interviews
• Coordinate client/company interviews and follow-ups
• Maintain candidate database and recruitment trackers
• Manage candidate pipelines and ensure timely closures
• Follow up with selected candidates until joining
• Handle bulk hiring and multiple positions simultaneously
• Coordinate with clients and internal teams for recruitment requirements
• Prepare daily/weekly recruitment MIS and reports
• Achieve assigned recruitment and joining targets Required Skills Strong sourcing & screening skills
 Good communication and interpersonal skills
 Candidate handling & follow-up
 Knowledge of recruitment portals
 Good negotiation and convincing skills
 Target-oriented approach
 Ability to handle bulk hiring
 Good MS Excel & recruitment MIS knowledge Preferred Experience: Candidates with experience in Manufacturing Recruitment / Contract Staffing / Bulk Hiring / Agency Recruitment will be preferred. Share your CV: kanchan@sslglobal.in
 Contact: 9343362177
